plan.notes: Amended before any evaluation: personal-study-3 stopped SOURCE_INVALID because SPLG's bars end on 2025-10-30 (the fund's ticker became SPYM on 2025-10-31); this plan reads SPYM instead and is otherwise unchanged. Registered before the run. Each rule is a published one with its published parameters (sources in personal/method.py RULES); nothing is fitted. The FULL window runs from the first decision 2017-01-31 to the last DEV session; its halves split at its middle session, each half a fresh $1000. BEATS_SPY_REPEATEDLY needs all of: excess log growth over SPY above 0 on the FULL window and on each half; FULL maximum drawdown at most 10 points worse than SPY's; ahead of SPY in at least 60% of rolling 36-month windows; FULL excess still above 0 at 20 bps a side. BEATS_SPY_PARTLY: FULL excess above 0 but another test failed. Otherwise DOES_NOT_BEAT_SPY. The DEV window (first decision 2019-10-22, personal-studies 1-2) is reported, not tested. The recommended direction is the BEATS_SPY_REPEATEDLY method with the largest FULL excess, the adopted sso-trend200 listed first so it wins ties; if none qualifies the report says so. The 90% stationary-bootstrap interval of the FULL annual excess and Holm over the ten new trials (FULL monthly active returns) are reported, not tested. DEV_CONTAMINATED: the forward record is the test.
